entry: Launcheré Disco yek launcher bu sabké metro ast ke barayé tajrobeyé kurbariyé qubelé scaxsisuzi va barruq tarruhi scode ast. Kurbarun mitavunand launcheré xod ru bu tanzim kardané anduzeyé kuscihu, tagcyir dudané juyguhé kuscihu, scaxsisuzi kardané pwsteyé rangi va tanzim kardané tasviré paszamineyé morede aluqeyescun scaxsisuzi konand.
list_featuers_0: Metro-Style Interface: A clean & modern design inspired by Windows Phone 8.
list_featuers_1: Customizable Tiles: Drag and drop tiles, adjust their sizes, and move them around to fit your unique style.
list_featuers_2: Theme Customization: Change the color of the launcher to match your mood or aesthetic.
list_featuers_3: Wallpaper Personalization: Choose and set your own wallpapers to create a fully personalized setup.
paragraph_contributing_0: Contributions are most welcome! Feel free to submit issues and pull requests to help improve Disco Launcher.
list_paragraph_contributing_1: Yek scuxeyé jadid baruyé vizcegi yu raföé esckulé xod ijud konid.
list_paragraph_contributing_2: Zamuni ke kodé scomu umude scod, yek darxusté kescesc ersul konid.
paragraph_license: In prozce tahté onvuné MIT mojavvez durad - baruyé jozöiyut fuylé MOJAVVEZ ru bebinid.
paragraph_contact_0: Baruyé har gwune soul yu buzxord, dar swraté tamuyol bu mu tamus begirid!
